brand.note: Benchmark-scoped trusted canonical brand data, not the future persistent brands registry. A migration to that registry must preserve this brand_id.

typography.note: Benchmark role mapping (configuration, not Brand Memory). Brand Memory carries only family + weights. Both fonts are variable: a weight is an instance (wght) of the same hash-checked bytes. No third family and no fallback. A text layer addresses a font by one reference, so each role has its own instance_ref (same resource, same hash-checked bytes, one wght instance).

Only metadata, hash and evidence are committed; the bytes live in the gitignored private location and are verified against this hash on load. CI does not need the file.

execution.why_pass: Every required gate returned PASS from measurement, none from assumption: Preflight PASS, all five Creative Fidelity checks PASS on the delivered PNG, all three Brand Guardian hard rules PASS, a real RESOLVED PNG with real typography, the real asset consumed, no fallback.
limits: The reference rendering and the candidate share the rasterizer's own image decoding and resampling: a defect inside the rasterizer is not detectable by these measurements.
Tolerances are the provisional technical ones; a measured difference of 0 here does not tighten them.
R1 constrains declared colours only, never the pixels of the photograph; R3 applies to IMAGE candidates and reports NOT_MEASURABLE for an image with no product-fidelity observation.

visual_inspection.note: Not a violated rule, so the verdict is unchanged. The creative is technically clean but plain: the product (the whole table-top photograph, accepted by decision) occupies about a third of the canvas width; the dark table background of the photograph is placed as is; the headline breaks after "Votre"; the price sits apart from the product with a large empty area below. None of these is an implemented rule.

approved_decisions.authentication: Owner authorization recorded for Benchmark 001; not authenticated by Nordla Identity, which remains an open dependency. The clock was read once, outside any builder.

decisions.statement: The Benchmark 001 canvas background is white (#FFFFFF), not cream. Cream (#FBF8F3) remains an allowed HABB colour token and is neither a required nor an authoritative HABB background.
The allowed declared colours are #183247, #C56E54, #FBF8F3, #FFFFFF, #0F2A52 and #C0392B. An allowlist: a creative need not use all six, and no semantic role is assigned to any of them.

The short copy "Vos souvenirs. Votre création." is an authorised HABB copy variant for Benchmark 001. This is a NEW approval; the longer line it comes from was approved earlier and that history is not rewritten.

The visible speed claim is "Coque personnalisée en 5 minutes", never an isolated "5 minutes". The operational qualification (in store, compatible model available, customer file usable) stays in the claim evidence and is not printed on the visual.

PIXEL_PRESERVE with the whole real photograph placed as a rectangular photo is the accepted form: no segmentation, no cut-out, no relight, no crop reconstruction, no generative transformation. A fixture decision, not a universal HABB creative rule.
The printed-text region of the real photograph is annotated (see asset_evidence.protected_regions) for the Fidelity TEXT check.

Exactly three minimum hard rules: R1 declared-colour allowlist, R2 text families within Playfair Display / Montserrat, R3 the product_fidelity gate must be PASS. Fixture choices are not converted into brand rules.

Provisional technical tolerances: rectangle ±1 px, aspect error ≤ 0.5%, colour mean absolute difference ≤ 0.5/255 and per-channel mean signed shift ≤ 1/255, protected-text region maximum difference ≤ 2/255. Rasterization and rounding tolerances, not aesthetic ones.
No new global minimum font-size rule is introduced now; the self-declared minimum remains a separate future concern.
